FS25 Production

Wholesome Foods

v1.0.0.0

A large food-production facility that turns farm ingredients into a wide range of finished Wholesome Foods products, with pallet and bulk-output support.

  • Multiple production recipes
  • Custom product pallets and packaging
  • Bulk unloading for supported products
